before12.styles: Instrumental post-hardcore rock, fixed 175 BPM in F Minor, straight 4/4 from the first bar through the final hit. Strong punchy kick and cracking snare carry an unmistakable full-speed running step throughout. Wide distorted guitars move Fm -> Ab -> Bbm -> C, first in short strikes and then broad sustained chords. Toms answer a crushing snare while the kick stays firm on the running beat. A high guitar line climbs through the final two chords; the full ensemble opens that line into the largest instrumental hook. Aim for about 3:31.
before12.exclude: vocals, spoken word, jazz, drill, half-time drums, tempo changes, beatless breakdown, ambient intro
before12.title: 12. 폭발 직전
